AL.notes: Ala. Code § 40-18-5. Top rate 5% above $3,000 single / $6,000 MFJ. Social Security and defined-benefit pensions exempt.
AL.name: Alabama

AR.notes: Ark. Code Ann. § 26-51-201 (Act 1 of 2024). Top rate 3.90%. Social Security exempt. $29 personal exemption tax credit ($58 MFJ). $6,000 retirement exclusion.
AR.name: Arkansas

AZ.notes: Flat 2.50% rate. Social Security benefits are 100% exempt from Arizona state tax (A.R.S. § 43-1022).
AZ.name: Arizona

CA.notes: California progressive tax 1.0% to 12.3% plus 1.0% Mental Health Services Tax on taxable income exceeding $1,000,000 (total top rate 13.3%). Social Security benefits are 100% exempt (Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code § 17087).
CA.name: California

CO.notes: Flat 4.40% rate (Colo. Rev. Stat. § 39-22-104). Social Security benefits 100% exempt age 65+ (or AGI <= $75k single / $95k MFJ under 65). Pension/annuity subtraction up to $20,000 (55-64) or $24,000 (65+) per person.
CO.name: Colorado

CT.notes: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 12-700 / § 12-701. Rates 2.0% to 6.99%. Social Security and pension/annuity/IRA distributions 100% exempt below $75k single / $100k MFJ AGI (SS capped at 25% of total benefits above threshold).
CT.name: Connecticut

DC.notes: D.C. Code § 47-1806.03. Progressive brackets 4.0% to 10.75%. Social Security exempt.
DC.name: District of Columbia

DE.notes: 30 Del. C. § 1102. Rates 2.2% to 6.6%. Social Security exempt. $110 personal exemption tax credit ($220 MFJ). $12,500 exclusion for ages 60+.
DE.name: Delaware

FL.notes: No state individual income tax (Fla. Const. art. VII, § 5).
FL.name: Florida

GA.notes: Flat 4.99% rate in 2026 (O.C.G.A. § 48-7-20, HB 463); $15k single / $30k MFJ personal exemption. Social Security exempt. Senior exclusion up to $35k (62-64) or $65k (65+) per person.
GA.name: Georgia

HI.notes: Haw. Rev. Stat. § 235-51. Rates 1.4% to 11.0%. Social Security and employer pensions 100% exempt.
HI.name: Hawaii

IA.notes: Flat 3.80% rate. Social Security benefits and all qualified retirement distributions (pensions, IRAs, 401k) are 100% exempt for taxpayers age 55+ (Iowa Code § 422.7).
IA.name: Iowa

ID.notes: Flat 5.30% rate for 2026 (Idaho Code § 63-3024, HB 40). Social Security benefits are 100% exempt from Idaho state income tax.
ID.name: Idaho

IL.notes: Flat 4.95% rate (35 ILCS 5/). Fully exempts Social Security benefits and qualified retirement plans (pensions, traditional IRAs, 401k/403b).
IL.name: Illinois

IN.notes: Flat 2.95% rate for 2026 (Ind. Code § 6-3-2-1). Social Security is 100% exempt. Counties may levy local income tax.
IN.name: Indiana

KS.notes: K.S.A. § 79-32,110 (2024 SB 1). Two brackets: 5.20% up to $23k single / $46k MFJ, 5.58% above. All Social Security benefits are 100% exempt.
KS.name: Kansas

KY.notes: Flat 4.0% rate (KRS 141.020). Social Security is exempt. Pension and qualified retirement exclusion up to $31,110 per person.
KY.name: Kentucky

LA.notes: La. R.S. § 47:32. Flat 3.00% rate. Social Security exempt. Federal and state public pensions 100% exempt.
LA.name: Louisiana

MA.notes: Massachusetts 5.0% base rate plus 4.0% surtax on taxable income exceeding $1,000,000 (Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 4). Social Security is 100% exempt.
MA.name: Massachusetts

MD.notes: Md. Code Ann., Tax-Gen. § 10-105. State rate 2.0% to 5.75% (counties levy local piggyback 2.25% to 3.20%). Social Security exempt. 2026 pension exclusion up to $40,600 for age 65+ (IRAs do not qualify).
MD.name: Maryland

ME.notes: 36 M.R.S. § 5111. Progressive rates 5.8% to 7.15%. Social Security exempt. Pension/annuity deduction up to $35,000.
ME.name: Maine

MI.notes: Flat 4.25% rate (MCL 206.51). Social Security is exempt. PA 4 of 2023 retirement subtraction fully phased in for 2026 ($67,610 single / $135,220 MFJ).
MI.name: Michigan

MN.notes: Minn. Stat. § 290.06. Progressive brackets 5.35% to 9.85%. Follows federal Social Security taxation with state subtraction.
MN.name: Minnesota

MO.notes: Mo. Rev. Stat. § 143.011. Top rate 4.70%. SB 190 fully exempts 100% of Social Security and public pensions.
MO.name: Missouri

MS.notes: Flat 4.0% rate (Miss. Code Ann. § 27-7-5). Social Security and all qualified retirement distributions (pensions, IRAs, 401k) are 100% exempt from Mississippi income tax.
MS.name: Mississippi

MT.notes: Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-2103 (SB 399). Two rates: 4.7% and 5.9%. Adopts federal standard deduction.
MT.name: Montana

NC.notes: Flat 3.99% rate in 2026 (N.C. Gen. Stat. § 105-153.7, Session Law 2023-134). Social Security benefits are exempt. Generous standard deduction.
NC.name: North Carolina

ND.notes: N.D. Cent. Code § 57-38-30.3 (HB 1158). Top rate 2.50%. Social Security benefits 100% exempt.
ND.name: North Dakota

NE.notes: Neb. Rev. Stat. § 77-2715 (LB 754). Top rate 4.55% for 2026. $166 personal exemption tax credit ($332 MFJ). LB 873 fully exempts all Social Security benefits.
NE.name: Nebraska

NH.notes: No individual earned income tax or tax on retirement distributions. The interest and dividends tax (RSA 77) phased out completely.
NH.name: New Hampshire

inheritanceTax.notes: New Jersey imposes inheritance tax on transfers to non-Class A beneficiaries.

NJ.notes: New Jersey Gross Income Tax 1.4% to 10.75% (N.J. Stat. Ann. § 54A:2-1). Social Security is 100% exempt. Substantial pension and retirement income exclusion ($100k MFJ / $75k Single) for filers 62+ with total income up to $100k.
NJ.name: New Jersey

NM.notes: N.M. Stat. Ann. § 7-2-7 (HB 252). Rates 1.5% to 5.9%. Social Security exempt for AGI < $100k single / $150k MFJ.
NM.name: New Mexico

NV.notes: No state individual income tax (Nev. Const. art. 10, § 1).
NV.name: Nevada

NY.notes: New York progressive rates 4.0% to 10.9% (N.Y. Tax Law § 601). Social Security is 100% exempt. Pension and annuity exclusion up to $20,000 per person age 59.5+.
NY.name: New York

OH.notes: Ohio 2026 consolidated flat bracket (Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02, HB 96): 0% on first $26,050 and flat 2.75% above $26,050 (3.125% top tier eliminated in 2026). Social Security is 100% exempt.
OH.name: Ohio

OK.notes: 68 O.S. § 2355. Top rate 4.75%. 100% Social Security exemption. $10,000 retirement income exclusion.
OK.name: Oklahoma

OR.notes: Or. Rev. Stat. § 316.037. Rates 4.75% to 9.90%. $236 personal exemption tax credit ($472 MFJ). Social Security benefits are 100% exempt.
OR.name: Oregon

inheritanceTax.notes: Pennsylvania imposes an inheritance tax on transfers to direct descendants (4.5%).

PA.notes: Flat 3.07% rate. Under 72 P.S. § 7301, Pennsylvania completely exempts Social Security benefits, public & private pensions, and 401(k)/traditional IRA distributions once retirement age (59.5) is reached.
PA.name: Pennsylvania

RI.notes: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-30-2.6. Rates 3.75% to 5.99%. Social Security exempt for AGI < $107k single / $133,750 MFJ.
RI.name: Rhode Island

SC.notes: S.C. Code Ann. § 12-6-510. Top rate 6.20%. Social Security 100% exempt. Senior retirement deduction up to $15,000.
SC.name: South Carolina

SD.notes: No individual income tax (S.D. Const. art. XI, § 2).
SD.name: South Dakota

TN.notes: No individual income tax (Hall income tax fully repealed Jan 1, 2021).
TN.name: Tennessee

TX.notes: No state individual income tax (Tex. Const. art. VIII, § 24-a).
TX.name: Texas

UT.notes: Flat 4.45% rate (Utah Code § 59-10-104, SB 71). Social Security follows federal taxable amount with nonrefundable credit (4.45% of taxable SS) phased out at 2.5% per dollar of MAGI above $54k single / $90k MFJ & HoH / $45k MFS.
UT.name: Utah

VA.notes: Virginia progressive rates 2.0% to 5.75% (Va. Code § 58.1-320). Social Security benefits are 100% exempt. Generous senior age-65 deduction up to $12,000 per spouse.
VA.name: Virginia

VT.notes: 32 V.S.A. § 5811. Progressive rates 3.35% to 8.75%. Social Security taxable subject to state exemption thresholds.
VT.name: Vermont

WA.notes: No personal income tax on ordinary income or retirement distributions. 7% excise tax on net LTCG over $290,000 up to $1M taxable gain, plus 9.9% above $1M taxable gain (RCW 82.87, ESSB 5813).
WA.name: Washington

WI.notes: Wis. Stat. § 71.06. Rates 3.50% to 7.65%. Social Security 100% exempt. $5,000 retirement exclusion for age 65+.
WI.name: Wisconsin

WV.notes: W. Va. Code § 11-21-4e (HB 2526). Rates 2.2% to 5.12%. Social Security 100% exempt by 2026. $8,000 retirement exclusion.
WV.name: West Virginia

WY.notes: No individual income tax (Wyo. Const. art. 15, § 18).
WY.name: Wyoming
